title: QUIC RFC 9000 CRYPTO Frame Focused Proof Work Item

- Link all S19P6 requirements to dedicated architecture, work-item, and verification artifacts.
- Regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage and run focused verification.
verification_plan: Run the focused S19P6 requirement-home filter, run a Release build, run the full Release no-build solution test suite, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, and check the diff for whitespace errors.

Replacing the span-backed CRYPTO frame view or frame-codec hot path.

completion_notes: Completed as focused proof over the existing CRYPTO frame codec, CRYPTO buffer overflow outcome, packet parser classification, and existing frame-codec benchmark floor.
